notes: Requested gloss "fatten" (active) adjusted to "be fatted": both of this root's only attestations (1Kgs.5.3, "fatted fowl"; Prov.15.17, "a stalled/fatted ox") are qal PASSIVE participles, describing an animal that has been fattened, not the active process of fattening it -- no finite qal form occurs anywhere in the corpus. Same pattern as the existing H7251 רבע² ("squared"), where an adjectival/stative gloss was used to match a participle-only attestation rather than forcing an active-infinitive gloss the citations don't support.
